leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a discriminated union type to represent API response states
Initialize state variables using the discriminated union type
Implement a function that returns different union members based on API conditions
Manipulate UI rendering logic to display content according to the current union member
Configure TypeScript type guards to narrow union types in conditional blocks
Integrate error handling by updating state with error union members
Apply pattern matching techniques to handle all possible union cases exhaustively
lessonTitle: Model API success error via discriminated unions
